call_points.text: Railways is about 23.5% of the order book.
A 10 MW data centre is expected to be commissioned by May 2027; two edge data centres in Mumbai and Gurgaon are already commissioned.
Data centre capacity is also being taken on lease from Anant Raj and Adani, with RailTel providing managed services on top.
Kavach orders take 30-35 months; outdoor work is advanced at East Central Railway and started at West Central Railway, with revenue expected this year.
No major Kavach tenders are expected this financial year as awarded tenders are still under execution.
Project margins are held at 4-5%; blended margin falls as the project share rises, which management calls arithmetic rather than segment weakness.
The flat Q1 profit was due to a non-cash ECL provision on aged debtors; management says no account is doubtful and it can reverse on payment.
International work is small: an Ethiopia data centre project of about ₹18 Cr, with bids in Uzbekistan, Sri Lanka and Vietnam.
CAG offered nil comments on the FY26 annual financial statements.

Data center revenue for FY26 was ₹202 crore compared to ₹127 crore in FY25.
Planned capex for FY27 is around ₹300 crore, primarily for data centers and telecom network.
Secured ₹24.91 Cr purchase order including tax from The New India Assurance Company for AI/ML based health insurance fraud monitoring solution to be executed by May 2029.

Q1FY27 order book ₹11,747 Cr, of which railways is about 23.5%.
RailWire ISP had 6.23 lakh subscribers in Q1FY27, about 50,000 more than a year earlier, with ARPU under pressure.
Kavach orders take 30-35 months to execute; revenue from Kavach orders is expected to start this year.

timeline.summary: RailTel received a ₹145.47 crore Letter of Acceptance from Eastern Coalfields Limited for telecom services.
RailTel received an LoA worth ₹20.35 crore including tax from the Directorate of Higher Education, Himachal Pradesh, for an MIS-Central Dashboard System.
RailTel received a ₹13.84 crore work order from the Directorate of Education, GNCTD for setting up computer labs and supplying laptops.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,668.86 Cr (+27.6% YoY), net profit ₹141.75 Cr (+24.9% YoY).
RailTel received an LoI worth ₹49.67 crore including tax from Additional Commissioner For Transport, Enforcement (South) for an ITMS project.
RailTel hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on 1 May 2026, guiding for ~20% revenue growth in FY27 and reporting an order book of ₹11,466 crore as of 30 April 2026.
RailTel awarded work for AI-based surveillance at New Delhi Railway Station by Ministry of Railways; value unfinalised.
RailTel received a ₹15.67 crore LoA from Sr. Dste, Jodhpur for railway double distant signalling work.
RailTel terminated a ₹26.73 crore OFC order from South East Central Railway due to unviable cost increases.
RailTel received an LoI worth ₹31.21 crore excluding tax from Newspace India Limited for IT infrastructure upgradation.
RailTel received ₹5.31 lakh fines each from NSE and BSE for non-compliance with board composition rules for the quarter ended 31 March 2026.
RailTel received a ₹41.32 Cr (excl. tax) work order from UP Police Recruitment Board for exam security services through June 2028.
RailTel received an ₹82.04 Cr LoA from Haryana Rail Infrastructure Development Corporation for railway signalling works to be executed by November 2027.
RailTel received a ₹48.98 crore work order from the Higher Education Department, Govt. Of Odisha for digital application modules.
2026-10-13: RailTel received a ₹197.18 crore work order from State Bank of India for continuation of MPLS links and P2P links for 5 years
2026-10-16: Railtel received a ₹167.52 crore LoA from Railway Recruitment Board Secunderabad for AM-RMS services
2026-10-16: RailTel received a ₹18.99 crore work order from Health Insurance TPA of India Ltd for IT infrastructure and cybersecurity solution for three years
On October 19, 2026, RailTel Corporation received a ₹47.40 crore rate contract from Haryana State Electronics Development Corporation for structured LAN.
2026-10-23: RailTel received a ₹20.04 crore LoI from Munitions India for setting up a DC & DR Center on IaaS platform.
Railtel Corporation Of India Limited Board of Directors declared interim dividend of Rs.1 per equity share, record date 30 Oct 2026, payment 20 Nov 2026.
RailTel received a ₹131.88 Cr 5-year LoA from Directorate of Postal Life Insurance as System Integrator for IMS through November 2031.
RailTel received a ₹27.38 Cr work order from The Cotton Corporation of India for cloud disaster recovery services through November 2031.
RailTel received a ₹22.78 Cr Letter of Acceptance from the Department of Posts for dedicated GPU compute and storage services through November 2031.
Railtel Corporation Of India Limited shared the audio recording link for its Analyst/Investor Conference Call on October 29, 2026, covering Q2 and H1 FY27 results.
RailTel received a ₹20.04 Cr purchase order from The Pune District Central Co-Operative Bank Ltd for integrated surveillance systems through October 2031.
